name: Bloodstone Choker
summary: In Stormwind, the Bloodstone Choker binds a warlock’s ritual to the void. Gakin the Darkbinder once held the bloodstone talisman, until an apprentice stole it and fled to the Defias Brotherhood.

sections.title: A Stolen Conduit
sections.body: The Bloodstone Choker once belonged to Gakin the Darkbinder, a warlock mentor in the chambers beneath Stormwind’s Slaughtered Lamb. His apprentice, Surena Caledon, betrayed him and stole the choker. She fled into Elwynn’s forests and joined the Defias Brotherhood, carrying the enchanted talisman with her. She is at the Brackwell Pumpkin Patch, where the choker must be reclaimed before the bandits can use its power.

sections.title: Taming the Void
sections.body: Carved from bloodstone, the choker can bridge the mortal world and the twisting shadows of the Twisting Nether. Gakin puts it to use in the crypts beneath the tavern, channeling its magic at the summoning circle to draw a hostile Voidwalker from the void. A warlock must subdue the furious creature in direct combat while wielding the talisman to prove the will to command such a guardian.

faq.answer: The Bloodstone Choker is an enchanted bloodstone necklace that warlocks use as a ritual conduit. Its magic can tear through reality and summon an unruly Voidwalker from the Nether.

aliases: where did the choker come from
faq.answer: Gakin the Darkbinder originally owned the choker. He trains warlocks in the covert basement beneath The Slaughtered Lamb in Stormwind’s Mage Quarter.
Surena Caledon stole the choker from her mentor, Gakin, then fled to join the Defias Brotherhood. She sought power among the bandits hiding in Elwynn Forest.

faq.q: How is the choker used in warlock training?
faq.answer: A warlock activates the recovered choker over the summoning circle in the crypts beneath The Slaughtered Lamb. It draws out a Voidwalker, which the aspiring warlock must defeat and subdue to command the demon.

angles.text: As an Alliance warlock, recovering the Bloodstone Choker marks a rite of passage from basic spellcraft to command of formidable demonic minions.
Surena Caledon’s flight to the Defias Brotherhood shows that outlaws in Elwynn seek dangerous occult relics to strengthen their rebellion against Stormwind.
